lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy8Bi8Mo8 (DyBiMo) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 119), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives each Bi, Dy, and Mo center nine geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances of roughly 2.81–3.32 Å, forming a single three-dimensional periodic component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between 9-vertex Bi and Dy polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing between 9-vertex Dy and Mo polyhedra.
